raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends amount corrections inside the daily delivery. A corrected record repeats the txn_id with record_version 2, and silver_transactions keeps both versions, which gives the 30 duplicate keys. The fix is to keep only the latest version per txn_id, before the POSTED filter, so a later non-POSTED version still removes the transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
